text: “Home is a feeling that you carry with you.”
name: Karolina

text: “Home... is very much an emotion and something which you feel deep within you... it doesn't have to necessarily be a place or a person, but just, it could be a sound, a taste, a smell.”
name: Sammy

text: “Maybe that's the reason why I don't have a towel and I use a travelling towel... I'm still not in my home.”
name: Eduardo

text: “I would never be like, oh, the mountain in Japan... home was our flat.”
name: Ellie

text: “I think it can't be found, I think you have to create it yourself... there's no perfect place for anyone where you just arrive and this is perfection.”
name: Theo

text: “I'm not coming back in a house. I'm coming back to a home and my home is my people, my family.”
name: Guilia
